contentCatalog.action.installDesc: Installs the version for the whole organization. A pinned installation does not follow automatic updates.
contentCatalog.action.requestedDesc: Another member with the right to install content approves or rejects it under Requests.
contentCatalog.action.rollbackDesc: Moves the installation back to an older version and pins it, so automatic updates stop.
contentCatalog.action.uninstallDesc: Removes the package from the organization. A package that another installed package depends on cannot be removed.
contentCatalog.action.updateDesc: Moves the installation to a newer version. Review what it asks for beyond the installed version.
contentCatalog.approval.desc: Ask a second member to approve every install, update, rollback and uninstall.
contentCatalog.approval.hint: Turning it on takes effect at once. Turning it off takes effect 24 hours later.
contentCatalog.approval.label: Require approval
contentCatalog.approval.pendingHint: Until then every change still needs approval. Turn it back on to cancel.
contentCatalog.approval.pendingTitle: Approval will be switched off at {time}
contentCatalog.approval.readOnly: Changing this needs the permission to manage organization settings.
contentCatalog.approval.savedOn: Approval is required from now on
contentCatalog.approval.savedPending: Approval will be switched off in 24 hours
contentCatalog.approval.title: Approval
contentCatalog.detail.pending: A request is waiting for approval
contentCatalog.detail.pendingHint: {action} {version}: no other change can start until it is decided.
contentCatalog.diff.same: No wider permissions than the installed version.
contentCatalog.diff.title: What this version asks for
contentCatalog.diff.widens: This version asks for more than the installed one
contentCatalog.diff.widensHint: Highlighted fields are wider than in the installed version.
contentCatalog.field.ack: Its license ({spdx}) does not allow use as a service. I confirm this organization may use it.
contentCatalog.field.pinHint: Automatic updates skip a pinned installation.
contentCatalog.pageDescription: Signed packages of rules, templates and other content. Installing one makes it available to the whole organization.
contentCatalog.request.approveDesc: The change is applied for the whole organization as soon as you approve it.
contentCatalog.request.rejectDesc: Nothing changes; the requester sees why.
contentCatalog.trust.indexExpired: The signed index has expired: new versions stop arriving until the next import.
contentCatalog.trust.noImport: The platform administrator imports a signed catalog bundle; its packages then appear here.
contentCatalog.trust.noImportTitle: No catalog has been imported yet
contentCatalog.trust.noRoots: This instance has no catalog trust root, so it cannot import packages. Ask the platform administrator.
contentCatalog.trust.noRootsTitle: The catalog is not set up
contentCatalog.trust.revocationsStale: The revocation list is past its expiry: sensors and tool adapters cannot be installed until the next import.
contentCatalog.trust.staleTitle: The catalog is out of date
